prompts.prompt:
Use case: identity-preserve.
Asset type: transparent 2D cartoon RUN CYCLE sprite sheet for a family platform game.
Input image 1 is the exact identity reference: Pattha concept B, not an existing sprite sheet. Create new drawn poses of THIS SAME ROBOT, preserve his green armor, large rounded head, black visor with TWO cyan oval eyes, metallic gray mouth plate and round side earpiece, green pointed fins on helmet and back, black joint cylinders and gloves, chunky green boots, thick black outlines and flat cel shading. Match the reference proportions and friendly face exactly; do not redesign.
Make ONE production sprite sheet with exactly EIGHT full-body frames in a regular 4-column x 2-row grid, read left to right then top to bottom, no labels and no lines. Every frame faces LEFT in the same three-quarter side view as the reference. Same scale, head size and lighting in every frame. Transparent RGBA background, no floor or shadows or dust. Equal-sized cells with clear transparent padding so poses never touch adjacent cells.
Animation: athletic believable robotic RUN, NOT a standing figure wiggling its legs. Arms swing opposite the legs at the shoulders and elbows; hips rotate subtly, torso leans left/forward about 10 degrees. Knees bend strongly, boots lift and roll, distinct long stride and compact passing poses, two airborne flight phases.
Frame 1: leftward lead boot extended left just contacting ground, rear boot far back right, opposing arms.
Frame 2: leading knee bends accepting weight, rear heel lifts, body lowers slightly.
Frame 3: passing: support leg nearly straight under hip, other knee drives forward with heel tucked.
Frame 4: flight: lead knee high and bent, rear leg pushes long behind, both boots clear ground.
Frame 5: opposite boot extended left contacting ground, reverse leg/arm roles from frame 1.
Frame 6: opposite stance absorption, reverse frame 2.
Frame 7: opposite passing, reverse frame 3.
Frame 8: opposite flight, reverse frame 4, flows smoothly to frame 1.
Keep the contact ground baseline aligned across grounded frames, very small vertical bounce only. Full silhouette never clipped. No extra fingers, limbs, weapons, characters, text, watermarks, scenery or motion lines. A cohesive animation asset, not eight unrelated illustrations.

Use case: identity-preserve.
Asset type: transparent 2D cartoon JUMP and LANDING sprite sheet for a family platform game.
Input image 1: exact identity reference Pattha concept B. Preserve green rounded armor, HUGE rounded head, black visor, TWO cyan oval eyes, gray metal mouth plate, circular ear piece on viewer-right, one pointed green helmet fin and pointed back fins extending toward viewer-right, black cylindrical joints and gloves, chunky green boots, thick black outlines and flat cartoon cel shading. Same proportions and same cartoon style as the reference, no redesign.
Create exactly EIGHT full-body NEW poses in one regular 4-column x 2-row sprite sheet, reading left to right then top to bottom. All eight robots face LEFT, the same three-quarter side view as reference; DO NOT mirror the second row. Same head size and body scale throughout. Equal cells, ample transparent margin, no overlap, no clipping. Truly TRANSPARENT RGBA background: no color haze, shadows, floor, clouds or scenery.
Pose 1: anticipation CROUCH, hips dropped substantially, both knees sharply bent, feet planted, torso forward, arms swung back ready to leap.
Pose 2: TAKEOFF extension, legs stretch forcefully from the knees and hips, boots point downward, arms drive forward/upward, torso tall. Clearly different from crouch.
Pose 3: RISING, both knees folded up toward torso, boots tucked behind/below, arms actively lift, head tilted slightly up.
Pose 4: APEX, relaxed legs begin opening under hips, arms out to balance, mild torso lean, neutral friendly eyes.
Pose 5: FALLING, boots extend DOWN ready to meet ground, knees softly bent, arms spread for balance, head looking slightly down. CLEARLY DIFFERENT silhouette from the tucked rising pose.
Pose 6: LANDING compression, feet planted wide, deeply bent knees and dropped hips, arms forward to absorb impact.
Pose 7: RECOVERY from landing, half bent knees straightening, arms settle, torso returns upright.
Pose 8: STOMP REBOUND, springy upward posture, one knee tucked and one foot pointing down, arms in happy balance, no weapon.
No dust included (game will generate subtle dust separately). No text, numbers, watermarks, labels, dividing lines, extra limbs, colors, eyes or objects. All eight must face LEFT. Consistent professional game animation drawings.

Use case: identity-preserve.
Asset type: transparent 2D cartoon IDLE and EXPRESSIONS sprite sheet for Pattha, family platform game.
Input image 1 is the exact character reference Pattha concept B. Preserve large rounded green helmet/head, black visor with TWO cyan oval eyes, gray metal mouth plate, circular ear piece on viewer-right, pointed green helmet fin/back fins, green armor, black cylindrical joints and gloves, chunky green boots and original body proportions. Same thick black outline, cheerful modern cartoon, cel shading and green/black/metal palette. No redesign or new costume.
Create exactly EIGHT full-body poses in one regular 4 columns x 2 rows sprite sheet, read left to right then top to bottom. Same standing foot baseline and SAME SCALE in every cell; character never clipped; ample transparent padding, poses don't cross cells. ALL eight face LEFT in the original same three-quarter view, no second-row reversal. Actual transparent RGBA background, no floor, no shadow, no color haze.
Frame 1: calm IDLE: feet planted, arms relaxed down, friendly open cyan oval eyes.
Frame 2: BLINK: EXACT same pose/position/shape as frame 1 but cyan eyes closed into two thin curved cyan lines. No other change.
Frame 3: gentle idle BREATH/weight shift, arms still relaxed and head level, small shift to back leg, open eyes.
Frame 4: THINKING, hand gently touches chin plate, head tilts slightly upward, other hand at hip, two open cyan eyes.
Frame 5: thinking BLINK, EXACT same thinking pose as frame 4 with the cyan eyes closed into curved lines.
Frame 6: BORED waiting: shoulders relax, slight head downward tilt, one hand supports cheek, half-lidded cyan eyes, friendly mild impatience without anger.
Frame 7: HELP/INTERACT: one gloved arm points gently forward-left, other relaxed, feet planted, head attentive.
Frame 8: CELEBRATE: both gloved fists raised cheerfully upward, feet planted, knees springy, happy open cyan oval eyes.
No text, numbers, labels, speech bubbles, dividing lines, watermarks, extra limbs/fingers/eyes, accessories or scenery. This is a consistent animation asset of ONE character. Preserve the identity reference.

Use case: identity-preserve.
Asset type: corrected transparent 2D cartoon eight-frame RUN CYCLE sprite sheet.
Input 1 is the identity reference Pattha concept B. Input 2 is the previous run sheet to correct. The previous run sheet's raised forward fist stays fixed and the second row reverses facing: FIX those animation errors while keeping Pattha's character and cartoon rendering.
Create ONE sheet, 4 columns x 2 rows, exactly eight full-body frames, ALL FACING LEFT with the circular earpiece on viewer-right, same three-quarter camera in both rows. Preserve green armor, large rounded head, black visor/two cyan eyes, gray mouth plate, helmet/back fins, dark articulated elbows/knees, chunky boots, thick outlines, cel shading, proportions.
Critical: NO CONSTANT RAISED FIST. BOTH ARMS visibly pump back-and-forth, opposite the legs. The near arm (on viewer-right shoulder) visibly alternates from hand BEHIND the hip on the right to hand AHEAD of the chest on the left, with elbows bent. Two separate legs alternate lead/support; dark joints connect correctly.
Frame 1: NEAR LEG leads forward LEFT with heel contacting; FAR LEG extends behind RIGHT. NEAR ARM swung BACK to the RIGHT of hip, FAR ARM forward LEFT.
Frame 2: NEAR LEG bent accepting weight, FAR knee folding behind. NEAR ARM back/right lower, FAR ARM forward/left.
Frame 3: NEAR support LEG under hip pushing back, FAR LEG knee driving forward LEFT, far heel tucked. NEAR ARM swinging toward forward/left, FAR ARM moving down/back.
Frame 4: airborne flight: FAR KNEE forward LEFT and high, NEAR LEG trails RIGHT long. NEAR ARM forward LEFT, FAR ARM behind RIGHT.
Frame 5: FAR LEG extended forward LEFT landing, NEAR LEG extended behind RIGHT. NEAR ARM forward LEFT, FAR ARM back RIGHT. NOT the same leg order as frame 1.
Frame 6: FAR LEG bent accepting weight, NEAR knee folding behind RIGHT. NEAR ARM forward/left lower, FAR ARM behind/right.
Frame 7: FAR support LEG under hip pushing back, NEAR LEG drives knee forward LEFT. NEAR ARM moving down/back RIGHT, FAR ARM swinging forward LEFT.
Frame 8: flight: NEAR KNEE forward LEFT high, FAR LEG trails RIGHT long. NEAR ARM BACK RIGHT, FAR ARM forward LEFT. Flows into frame 1.
Torso leans slightly forward LEFT, knees visibly flex, boots lift. Keep scale and ground baseline consistent in all frames; grounded frame heels align; flight frames clear floor slightly.
Each frame wholly within its own equal cell with EXTRA TRANSPARENT PADDING: no limb crossing cell boundary, no clipping. Actual transparent RGBA background, no floor, shadows, dust, haze, numbers, text, labels, dividers, weapons, extra fingers/limbs, watermarks or scenery. A continuous professional run cycle, not repeated standing poses.

Use case: precise-object-edit.
This image is the EDIT TARGET, an eight-frame cartoon robot run sprite sheet. Make one targeted correction: REPAINT THE ARMS INTO A NATURAL ALTERNATING RUN SWING. Keep every head, face, torso, leg pose, boot, scale, frame location, green/black/metal palette and thick outline exactly as it is in the target. Keep eight frames, same layout and each frame's existing facing direction.
The front fist must not stay raised throughout the cycle. BOTH elbows are bent roughly 90 degrees, upper arms pump forward and backward from shoulders. Hands swing between chest height in front and hip height behind, opposing the lead leg. In frames 1 and 2 the arm on the visible round shoulder must swing FORWARD across the chest while the other arm swings BACK beside the hip. Frames 3 and 4 arms pass through a relaxed downward bent-elbow position. Frames 5 and 6 reverse the arms: visible shoulder's arm BACK by the hip, other arm FORWARD. Frames 7 and 8 return through the passing position. Clearly distinct arm silhouettes, dark cylindrical elbow joints connected, no disconnected or duplicated limbs. Keep the head and legs unchanged.
Background must remain actual transparent RGBA. No text, motion lines, scenery, shadows, haze, numbers, watermarks or grid borders. Only fix the arms.
